content: {"like":["Prefers engaging, well-paced narratives that keep the audience interested.","Values strong, memorable characters and rich, layered performances.","Enjoys films with timeless period settings and high production quality.","Appreciates movies that are good on Blu‑ray and in HD.","Likes stories that feel like a good movie with compelling storytelling."],"dislike":["Dislikes slow, factually heavy storytelling that drags the plot.","Avoids content with excessive dancing or over‑analysis of issues.","Rejects subdued tones that lack energy and vibrancy.","Dislikes abrupt endings that rely on footnotes or filler.","Prefers not to watch films that feel dated or lack modern relevance."]}
